Apple Legacy Contact review: digital legacy verdict

By the Afterkeep research team · Reviewed on 15 Oct 2026 · Independent: sponsors can't buy a verdict · How we rate

Verdict: Free and essential for iPhone users. Without it, even close family can find it very hard to get into iCloud photos and data. Best for: Anyone storing photos, messages or files in iCloud.

Top pick

Best for

Anyone storing photos, messages or files in iCloud.

Skip if

you don't use iCloud

Pros

  • Free, built into Settings
  • You can add more than one Legacy Contact, and they don't need an Apple device
  • Contacts get an access key; Apple verifies the death certificate

Cons

  • Excludes iCloud Keychain (passwords, passkeys, payment info) and purchased movies, music, books and subscriptions
  • Access is time-limited after approval (check Apple's page for details)
